measures.title: Barnstable County charter study commission
measures.summary: Asks whether a charter study commission should be created to study how Barnstable County government is currently structured. The commission would make findings about the county's form of government and recommend changes. Commissioners for each town are elected on the same ballot.
measures.yesMeans: A charter study commission would be created to study Barnstable County's government and make recommendations.
measures.noMeans: No charter study commission would be created.
